* '''PC-E1''' ([[Supremacy: Bridge (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 25]] (8 August 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 4, file created 10 August 2025: “'''Light Side:''' Unless your piloted [Resistance] starship at a system, Force drain -1 here. '''Dark Side:''' While you control, Supremacy is power + 3.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Supremacy: Bridge]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Supremacy: Bridge]] (published 8 August 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Supremacy: Bridge”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
